svg.title: Arduino LED
svg.desc: Uno D13 connects through a 220 ohm resistor and red LED to GND1. Breadboard insertion locations and LED polarity are labeled. W_LED_POLARITY: LED reversed as explicitly requested; input preserved.
svg.metadata: {"version":"0.1.0","logical":[["led.A","uno.GND1"],["led.K","r1.2"],["r1.1","uno.D13"]],"physical":[["led.A","uno.GND1"],["led.K","r1.2"],["r1.1","uno.D13"]],"placement":{"leads":{"r1.1":"E10","r1.2":"E14","led.K":"C14","led.A":"C15"},"jumpers":[{"pin":"uno.D13","hole":"A10"},{"pin":"uno.GND1","hole":"A15"}]},"license":"CC BY-SA 4.0","attribution":"Board geometry derived from Arduino UNO-TH Rev3e / A000066. Artwork simplified, scaled and annotated by Bread."}

g.text: GND / GND1 = socket between AREF and D13
The physical socket stays fixed when the signal pin changes.
Leads gently bent; body shown raised.
Rows and center gap are isolated.
No power rails in this fixed model.
3 electrical nets · 2 jumper wires · internal strip joins resistor to LED
W_LED_POLARITY: LED reversed as explicitly requested; input preserved.
Board geometry: Arduino UNO R3 (A000066), adapted. Illustrations: CC BY-SA 4.0 · Bread PoC 0.1
